concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-capital-get-grant-offers]] — 2026-09-15 Capital offer-choice hub comparing dynamic amount ranges with static fixed amount-term offers, conditional counts and pilot variable 90/180/360-day repayment terms; no offer or funding outcome.
warnings: Pilot qualifier is expressly for variable repayment terms, not all Capital financing or every offer function.
Up-to-three/up-to-nine offers and example amounts are conditional on processing history and available terms, not guaranteed user eligibility or limits.
This hub does not establish API roles, country eligibility, calculation-to-formal-offer conversion, expiry, ToS acceptance or funded-grant state; child/source routes are required.
